maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is rent from leasing open-air shopping centers, not repair, servicing or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Rent comes from private retail tenants such as grocers and retailers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Shopping-center REIT that has mostly been selling and spinning off assets, not rolling up companies.

mission_critical.reason: Retail tenants lease space and can relocate at lease end; switching is not operationally critical.
